subject: Garen first death 2:13
context: Darius used Flash + Ghost vs Sylas at 0:53, so he can't extend early trades. Garen has Flash + Ignite. Play more aggressive.

notes.text: Trading level 1 when the minion waves meet.
notes.data: fine to trade early because the opponent had no summoner spells

notes.text: Trade on the level-2 timer. Garen walked off as Darius hit level 2, while Garen was one melee minion short of level 2. He then took W instead of Q, so he couldn't use Q with full Conqueror stacks. Darius hit the Q handle (no heal). With Flash + Ignite against no summoners, Garen probably had a kill.
notes.rule: Level-2 race: solo laners hit level 2 on the first melee minion of wave 2. Stay in the fight if you're about to level and the opponent has no summoner spells.

notes.text: Even with the misplay, Garen came out ahead in the trade.
Hit by a Darius Q poke and gave no damage back. Darius healed from it.
Walked up and used E on the wave. Darius punished the cooldown, hit level 3 during the fight, and pulled Garen into a long trade Garen couldn't fight back in, a level down. Garen died.
notes.rule: Don't use your main trading ability on the wave when the opponent is about to level and can punish it.
